pins.definition: Before the usual or expected time, or near the beginning of the day or a period.
Near the beginning of the day or of a period of time.
Happening or done before the usual or expected time, or near the beginning of the day.

situation: A baker arrives at their shop to find the doors still locked while the city streets remain completely empty and dark.
subject: the arrival time
brief: A baker in a white apron stands before the heavy, locked wooden door of a bakery on a silent, pitch-black city street. A large wall clock above the entrance is glowing brightly, its hands clearly showing it is long before opening time, while the baker looks at the clock with a sigh, holding a ring of iron keys in their hand.
